title: Death by a Thousand Directions: Exploring the Geometry of Harmfulness in LLMs through Subconcept Probing
reasoning: The paper focuses on mechanistic interpretability and activation space steering to mitigate harmful outputs in Large Language Models. While it addresses safety concerns and subconcepts like racial hate, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious traditions, theology, or provide a philosophical analysis of morals and ethics; its approach is primarily technical and centered on AI safety engineering.
